# 1.37.0-beta.9

Ninth beta of 1.37.0: small improvements.

## Agent browser

- Page dialogs no longer stop the agent. A "Leave site?" question, a message, a confirmation or a request to type text used to freeze the agent's browser: it could not click, read the page or go to another address. Now the browser answers them itself: it leaves the page when the agent goes elsewhere, closes messages, confirms the step the agent has just taken and cancels requests to type text. The agent is told what each dialog said.

## Chat

- While the open chat is answering, the "To the end of the chat" button shows three dots in the accent color, so you can see work is going on below. They play little figures in random order, at their own pace and with short pauses: one hops over the others, two trade places, the row spins, folds into a turning triangle, runs a wave or bounces. With animations turned off the dots stand still.
